acceptance_tests: Proposal fingerprint and all bundle artifacts pass ready validation before DSP source is added.
One parent build links the exact Tide Pit and Generative Drums public Cores with one Instrument Lab authority and both source suites still pass.
The same absolute event timeline produces identical accepted traces, capture boundaries, PCM, and metrics at 16, 64, 128, and 512 frame partitions.
First capture length is in 24000 through 1536000 frames, starts inclusively, stops exclusively, and establishes phase zero and the session cycle.
Later captures start at the next phase-zero boundary, record one cycle of selected-source audio, and commit with a bounded owner swap.
Cancel, short first take, overflow, unsupported process shape, and source failure preserve the prior committed layer bytes.
Prepare owns four preallocated stereo float buffers and repeated process calls allocate nothing, take no lock, perform no I/O, and emit finite bounded output.
Source controls terminate at the existing Tide Pit and Generative Drums reducers while inactive source state is preserved and not advanced.

Synthetic Launch Control 3 tests exhaustively compare DAW enable, cleanup, modes, relative encoders, Page and Track controls, layer actions, Shift-clear, resync, LEDs, encoder positions, OLED messages, and invalid MIDI with this bundle map.
The authenticated JUCE 8.0.15 Layerwell.app target configures, compiles, and links without app launch or endpoint access.
Focused, affected-source, sanitizer, objective render, fresh-root, and routine-current checks pass after implementation freeze.
RESULTS.md and GAPS.md keep target-build, real-time, connected-device, listening, distribution, and production evidence independent.

may: Choose prototype-local class and file names, fixed storage ownership, event representation, snapshot transport, restrained UI layout, colors, and diagnostic wording.

must_not: Change either source instrument DSP, public mapping, source state, defaults, labels, hashes, dependency authority, or retained evidence.
Add arbitrary source discovery, plug-in hosting, external synchronization, persistence, sample editing, more sources, or more layers.
Allocate canonical Schuss identities or change catalogs, schemas, providers, factories, application-library records, accepted graphs, or production runtime.
Infer a different controller model, faders, endpoint receipt, physical success, real-time behavior, listening quality, distribution readiness, or production status.
Launch the app, open audio or MIDI endpoints, configure hardware, stage, commit, push, upload, flash, publish, or overwrite inherited Task 041 work.

goal.primary_claim: One integer session phase plus a provisional staging-owner swap can produce three source-only aligned layers with partition-independent accepted state and PCM while the exact embedded source Cores and a regular Launch Control 3 surface remain cleanly separated.
goal.why: The performer needs a small standalone instrument for browsing, shaping, capturing, and layering existing Schuss sources without constructing Ableton tracks, virtual audio routing, or another general sampler workstation.
